evidence_location.quote: RNA Isolation and Microarray Analysis Total RNA from PBMCs (~1.5 × 10^6 cells) was purified using Trizol (Invitrogen, Life Technologies Corporation) according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Samples were checked for purity and hybridized on Human U133 Plus 2.0 Arrays (Affymetrix).

Flow Cytometry Analysis.readouts: NK cell frequencies, NK cell subset frequencies, monocyte subset frequencies, CD69 activation marker expression, CCR5 expression, CD86 expression, geometric mean fluorescence intensity (MFI)

evidence_location.quote: Flow Cytometry Analysis 2–3 × 10^6 PBMCs were thawed and stained with live/dead marker (Alexa Fluor 430, Life Technologies) to exclude dead cells. Cells were then stained with an appropriate antibody cocktail. Cells were washed, fixed, and analyzed on the LSRII flow cytometer (BD).

hemagglutination-inhibition (HAI) antibo.readouts: influenza antibody titers, fold change in HAI titer, seroconversion/high-versus-low responder status, persistence of antibody response at day 180

evidence_location.quote: We evaluated the plasma antibody responses of all vaccinated individuals via hemagglutination-inhibition (HAI) antibody titer assays.

aliases: miRNA expression profiles of 672 human miRNAs
miRNA expression profiling.readouts: miRNA expression levels, differentially expressed miRNAs, miRNAs correlated with HAI response

evidence_location.quote: To assess whether or not miRNAs contribute to the differences in response we saw between young and elderly vaccinees, we measured the miRNA expression profiles of 672 human miRNAs on days 1, 3, and 7 after vaccination from a subset of subjects in the 2010 cohort (Figure 7A).
